note_en: 与其说…不如说… means "not so much X as Y": 他真正关心的，与其说是时间旅行本身，不如说是这种旅行最终会把人类带向怎样的社会 "what concerned him was not so much time travel itself as where it would lead society." The 与其说 part is the less accurate description and the 不如说 part the better one, so the order is the same as in English.
